Use the following key to translate the given formula of PL to natural, English sentences.
A: Marina reads a Percy Jackson book.
B: Izzy plays Minecraft.
C: Emily stops working.
D: Russell makes dinner.
E: Ashleigh stops by.
(~A ∨ ~B) ⊃ C
Option A: If neither Marina reads a Percy Jackson book nor Izzy plays Minecraft, then Emily stops working.
Option B: If it's not the case that both Marina reads a Percy Jackson book and Izzy plays Minecraft, then Emily stops working.
Option C: Either Marina not reading a Percy Jackson book or Izzy not playing Minecraft entails that Emily stops working.
Option D: Emily stopping working is a sufficient condition for either Marina not reading a Percy Jackson book or Izzy not playing Minecraft.
